{"consolidated_memory":"Lock timeout problems in storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql - THREE SEPARATE OCCASIONS

OCCASION 1: [2026-05-05]
- Manifestation: Lock timeout only for clients pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: Two writes not wrapped in transaction
- Signal: Lock wait tripping statement timeout
- Repro: Run migration against loaded table
- Fix: Wrapped both writes in one transaction (PR #4746 on branch fix/lock-timeout-1)
- Result: Reclaimed 94 GB of blob storage

OCCASION 2: [2026-05-24]
- Manifestation: Lock timeout only for traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- Root cause: Race condition in lazy initialization
- Signal: Lock wait tripping statement timeout
- Repro: Run migration against loaded table
- Fix: Guarded initialization with double-checked lock (PR #6227 on branch fix/lock-timeout-2)
- Result: Flaky test reduced from 89 failures per 100 runs to zero

OCCASION 3: [2026-08-29]
- Manifestation: Lock timeout only for payloads above roughly two megabytes
- Root cause: Floating point rounding in the money path
- Signal: Lock wait tripping statement timeout
- Repro: Run migration against loaded table
- Fix: Moved arithmetic to integer minor units (PR #7646 on branch fix/lock-timeout-3)
- Result: Throughput increased 69%, reaching 915 requests per second

All three incidents occurred in the same corner of storage/sql/migrations/0042_add_index.sql, with context carrying over across fixes."}
